description:
Use this policy setting to configure the use of digits in the Windows Hello for Business PIN.

A value of 1 corresponds to “Required.” If you configure this policy setting to 1, Windows Hello for Business requires users to include at least one digit in their PIN.

A value of 2 corresponds to “Disallow.” If you configure this policy setting to 2, Windows Hello for Business prevents users from using digits in their PIN.

If you do not configure this policy setting, Windows Hello for Business requires users to use digits in their PIN.

options.displayName: Allows the use of digits in PIN.
options.description: Allows the use of digits in PIN.

options.displayName: Requires the use of at least one digits in PIN.
options.description: Requires the use of at least one digits in PIN.

options.displayName: Does not allow the use of digits in PIN.
options.description: Does not allow the use of digits in PIN.
